description: This file defines the WPTServe class responsible for starting, stopping, and managing the Web Platform Tests (WPT) server used in layout testing. It includes server configuration, process management, and environment setup.

classes.name: WPTServe
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle of the WPT server used in layout tests, including server startup, shutdown, and process management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WPTServe instance, setting up server configuration, environment variables, and start command.

methods.name: _stop_running_server
methods.description: Stops the running WPT server and removes the PID file.

methods.name: _check_and_kill_wptserve
methods.description: Checks if the WPT server process is running and attempts to kill it if necessary.
